creativeBrief.audience: Young adults who feel distracted by their phones and want to reconnect with people who matter
creativeBrief.viewerPromise: A short, human story showing how attention lost to endless scrolling can be repaired through one honest act of reconnection
creativeBrief.hook: A friend waits for a promised meeting while the protagonist keeps scrolling
creativeBrief.payoff: The protagonist finally puts the phone away, shows up, apologises and listens; the friendship begins to recover
creativeBrief.narrationRationale: This is a dialogue-free visual short. A repeated unread message, the same friend waiting and the eventual face-to-face meeting carry the plot. Short on-screen lines provide essential context; music, silence and concrete sound effects support the action instead of replacing it.
creativeBrief.visualGrammar: Cinematic 2D story staging with deliberate changes between wide establishing views, phone/prop inserts, close reactions, hand details and two-shots. Cool isolated night spaces gradually give way to warmer practical light. The phone and the shadow are recurring visual motifs; actor and prop movement must remain readable.
creativeBrief.pacingRationale: Use 4-second inserts and reaction beats, 5-second travel and transition beats, and 6-second emotional holds. Timing follows action, reading time and the music arc rather than a fixed grid. Preserve the 45–51 second silence/loop beat and leave the final title long enough to land.
